subject: Where customer data is processed — technical evidence request
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@finbridge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Data processing / residency questions for procurement

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick demo yesterday. Procurement and our security team have a handful of follow-ups before we proceed:

1) Can you confirm the regions where request payloads and model responses are processed for the hosted API (both control plane and inference path)? Specifically we need to know if any part of requests/responses or logs ever leave the EU when the account is configured for EU-only.

2) Which subprocessors are involved in each hop (ingress LB, model inference, ephemeral cache, telemetry/observability, audit logs, backups)? We need an inventory or a short CSV we can include with the contract.

3) What cross-border transfer controls or standard contractual clauses (SCCs) do you rely on today? Also, is there a mechanism for EU-only tenancy (no US processing at all) on the hosted product or do we need Dedicated/Private?

4) Retention/deletion: what is the default retention for request logs, trace data, and any persisted context (e.g., for streaming/function calls)? What are the SLAs for deletion after contract termination?

We'd appreciate any evidence (SOC 2 abstract, subprocessor list, processing map) to attach to the procurement file. Procurement asked for an initial packet by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Security & Compliance
FinBridge
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data processing / residency questions for procurement

Hi Elena — thanks, great questions. Looping in Marissa (security & compliance) and Ben (infrastructure) so we can provide a concise packet. High-level answers below; we’ll attach the docs and a CSV shortly.

- Regions / processing:
  • Control plane (auth, billing, policy) is currently hosted in the EU (Frankfurt) for EU accounts.
  • Inference execution for hosted EU accounts is constrained to EU GPU pools; model tokenization, attention kernels, and KV cache execution occur on EU infrastructure.
  • Persistent telemetry/audit logs are stored in EU in the EU tenancy. We do not replicate production logs to the US for EU-hosted accounts.

- Subprocessors (summary): AWS EU regions (primary compute & object storage), Fastly (edge routing), Datadog (observability), Sentry (error traces), HashiCorp Vault (managed KMS), and a small set of analytics partners for usage aggregation. Ben will attach the detailed inventory.

- Cross-border transfers / controls:
  • We rely on SCCs + our Data Processing Addendum.
  • For Hosted EU accounts we operate an EU-only data path; no US fallback for request bodies or logs unless explicitly enabled by customer.
  • If you require an isolated control plane completely managed in your VPC (no Redwood-hosted control plane), we recommend Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) or a Dedicated EU-only reserved pool.

- Retention & deletion:
  • Default request/log retention: 30 days (configurable).
  • Ephemeral KV cache used for model context is in-memory on GPU and flushed on instance termination — not persisted to object storage.
  • Deletion SLA after contract termination: metadata & logs purged within 30 days; backups retained only if contractually required and otherwise deleted per DPA.

We can get you the SOC 2 abstract and the subprocessor CSV by EOD. Marissa / Ben — can you confirm exact list for the CSV and attach SOC 2 abstract + processing map?

Thanks — Jonas
Head of Product, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Elena Morales <elena@finbridge.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Data processing / residency questions for procurement

Quick clarifications from infra/compliance side (pinging Elena for visibility):

- Persistent artefacts: audit logs and billing records are written to encrypted S3 in eu-central-1. Replication to other regions is disabled for EU tenancy.
- Telemetry: aggregate metrics sent to Datadog EU instances; error payloads to Sentry EU (PII scrubbed by default).
- KV cache: strictly in-GPU or local ephemeral SSD, never offloaded to long-term storage.
- Backups: model weights are in vendor-managed object storage inside EU; we do not snapshot customer request content as part of model weights.
- SCC details: we use the latest EU Commission SCCs and provide a standard DPA; for enterprise we can provide vendor-specific contractual language and support additions to the DPA.

Attaching the subprocessor inventory and a high-level processing map to the thread. Ben, please confirm the fastly/pop and KMS operator versions in the CSV row.

—Marissa
Sr. Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

Hi Elena / Procurement team —

Thanks for the patience, attaching the packet we discussed:
- Redwood-Processing-Map-2027.pdf — visual path of requests, control plane, inference, and log stores (EU tenancy highlighted).
- subprocessor-inventory-2027.csv — complete vendor list and EU region endpoints.
- SOC2-TypeII-Abstract.pdf — executive summary; full report available under NDA.

Short summary for procurement:
1) EU-only hosted accounts: all request processing, inference, and persistent logs can be confined to EU regions. No automatic US transfer for request/response bodies or logs.
2) Dedicated / Private options: if you need a private control plane or an on-prem option, we support both (we can provide an implementation schedule and pricing estimate).
3) Retention: default 30 days for request logs (configurable); deletion SLA 30 days post-termination unless otherwise negotiated. Ephemeral model caches are non-persistent by design.
4) Controls: SCCs + DPA; KMS integration for customer-managed keys available for Dedicated/Private; audit logs and access logs available on request.

Next steps: if this satisfies the packet, let us know and we’ll share the tailored DPA + SCC attachments and a Draft SOW for Dedicated (if you want an isolated EU pool). Otherwise tell us any gaps and we’ll fill them.

Best regards,
Jonas Weber
Head of Product — Redwood Inference
